subject: 🌎 Don't miss out | Join us for day 1 of Axios House at Climate Week and UNGA
body_text:
96 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 RSVP to Axios House 
 Hello Axios insider,  

  

 
  The countdown to Axios House is on. Don't miss your chance to join us for three days of newsworthy events at Climate Week and the UN General Assembly. 

 
  ➡️ Be in the room. RSVP to hear from the leaders shaping the future of energy, climate and global affairs. 
 🗓️ When: Monday, September 21, 2026 - Wednesday, September 23, 2026 

 📍 Where: New York City, N.Y.  

 
 

   ⬇️ Register to attend: Day 1 at Axios House 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 
 Join us  for an event on the intersection of technology, energy and climate. We’ll gather leaders across business, government and technology to discuss how innovation and policy can help meet growing energy needs, unlock new climate solutions and build a more resilient and sustainable economy. 

  

 🗓 When:  Monday, September 21, 2026 | 10:00am - 11:30am ET 

 

 
🎙 Axios will host one-on-one conversations with: 

 

 
 Josh Parker
 Head of Sustainability, NVIDIA

 The Honorable Brian Schatz
 Senator, Hawaii

 
 Additional speakers to be announced. 

 

   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us  for an event on building the energy infrastructure of the future. We’ll gather electricity, technology, manufacturing and policy leaders to discuss aligning investment with innovation, advancing cleaner technologies and developing a skilled workforce to facilitate what comes next.

  

 🗓 When:  Monday, September 21, 2026 | 12:30pm - 2:00pm ET 

 

 🎙 Axios will host one-on-one conversations with: 

 

 Eric Gray
 Chief Executive Officer, Power, GE Vernova

 View From the Top segment moderated by Nicholas Johnston 

 Kara Hurst
 Chief Sustainability Officer, Amazon

 Jigar Shah
 Host, Energy Empire

 Varun Sivaram
 Founder and CEO, Emerald AI

   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 Join us  for a conversation about how valuing nature is reshaping business, investment and conservation—and how leaders across the public, private and nonprofit sectors are redefining our relationship with the natural world.

  

 🗓 When:  Monday, September 21, 2026 | 3:o0pm - 4:30pm ET

 

 🎙 Axios will host one-on-one conversations with: 

 

 Sylvia Earle
 Founder, Mission Blue

 Dr. Andrew Forrest AO*
 Executive Chairman and Founder, Fortescue

 Founder, Minderoo Foundation and Tattarang 

 View From the Top segment moderated by Axios co-founder Mike Allen 

 
 Ryan Gellert
 CEO, Patagonia

 Alex Taylor*
 Chairman and CEO, Cox Enterprises

 View From the Top segment moderated by Axios co-founder Mike Allen 

 
 *Denotes a panel segment 

 

   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Register 
 
 Join us for an event exploring the role of culture and influence in shaping the climate conversation. We’ll gather leaders across entertainment, business and environmental advocacy to discuss how their platforms can inspire action, mobilize communities and bring new audiences into efforts to protect the planet.  

  

 
 🗓 When:  Monday, September 21, 2026 | 4:30pm - 5:00pm ET 

  

 

 
🎙 Axios will host one-on-one conversations with: 

 

 
 
 
 Maggie Baird
 Founder, Support + Feed
